caution_findings.evidence_context: General LPS/teichoic-acid/macromolecular synthesis statements in the Introduction are background and are not counted as direct mechanism evidence for these peptides.
Figure-level membrane permeability and cytotoxicity curves are available as figures/captions, but exact per-timepoint numeric values are not locally tabulated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly tests peptide-induced S. pseudintermedius SP3 membrane permeabilization with propidium iodide fluorescence at 5X and 10X MIC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RRIKA, RR, WR-12, IK8 D isoform, Penetratin, and (KFF)3K against S. pseudintermedius SP3
mechanism_claims.limitations: The figure reports time-course fluorescence patterns rather than a fully tabulated numeric endpoint in the XML.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Transmission electron microscopy shows peptide-treated SP3 cells with membrane/cell-wall disruption, pore formation, lysed cells, or altered septa depending on peptide and concentration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphologic observations are qualitative and peptide-specific; no exact numeric pore frequency is tabulated locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill and growth-kinetics assays support rapid bactericidal activity and turbidity reduction, consistent with a membrane-damaging profile for several peptides.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Peptides at 5X MIC against MRSP SP3
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional killing/growth data support the mechanism but do not alone identify a molecular target.
